title: Zn-citrate and Zn-GSH in Various Organisms and Environments
summary: This cluster is about the presence and interactions of Zn-citrate and Zn-GSH in various organisms and environments. S. cerevisiae, a yeast, has Zn-GSH and Zn-citrate, and is cultivated with maltose and peptone. E. coli and yeast cytosol also have Zn-GSH and Zn-citrate, respectively. Zn-citrate is found in breast milk, coconut water, and yeast cytosol, and is bound to citrate. The Duroc process has parts Landace and Yorkshire.
